# Exact repo paths exempt from scripts/ci/check_blob_size.py (binaries over 500 KiB, and new
# files over 500 KiB). One path per line; no globs, no directories. Keep this list short: every
# entry is a file whose bytes every clone carries again each time it changes.
#
# Admit a path only when the file must ship at its size AND legitimately changes (a generated
# icon, an installer asset). A large file added once and never touched again does not need an
# entry: only adding or modifying it is judged. Editing this file needs a hermes-agent-core review
# (CODEOWNERS: /.github/).

# fails any PR that changes the master without committing this re-render.
